answer: A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The zenith counter is kept in karst and nadir makes public each reset. Anyone thus has to keep each alias continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2088 identities would post 2964 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
